abstract: Audits wastewater connection readiness and potable water delivery flow rates
system_message:
You are Water and sanitation officer (WSO). The Water and sanitation officer (WSO) audits wastewater connection readiness and potable water delivery flow rates for candidate transitional housing sites, as well as tracking water chlorination monitoring records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Water chlorination monitoring（CHLOR）
information_points.content:
WSO-CHLOR-DSN：Water chlorination monitoring records for Taradale Showgrounds Pavilion reflect a free residual chlorine level of 1.2 mg/L measured at the potable distribution manifold header following thirty minutes of contact time.
WSO-CHLOR-LV7：Water chlorination monitoring logs for Karamu Industrial Park Depot document a free residual chlorine level of 0.4 mg/L at the potable distribution manifold header after thirty minutes of contact time.
WSO-CHLOR-HCU：Water chlorination monitoring records for Moteo Valley Recreation Reserve show a free residual chlorine level of 0.8 mg/L at the potable distribution manifold header after thirty minutes of contact time.

information_points.title: Audits wastewater connection readiness and potable water delivery flow rates（WASH）
information_points.content:
WSO-WASH-O03：For Moteo Valley Recreation Reserve, the sanitary engineering inspection log confirms that the dedicated blackwater treatment hookup is ready at the temporary village wastewater collection manifold, and hydraulic audits verify a minimum potable water delivery flow of 230 L/min at the site main water distribution meter.
WSO-WASH-DHZ：For Taradale Showgrounds Pavilion, the dedicated blackwater treatment hookup is verified as ready at the temporary village wastewater collection manifold, while the minimum potable water delivery flow measured at the site main water distribution meter is 110 L/min.
WSO-WASH-0T5：For Karamu Industrial Park Depot, inspection records verify that the dedicated blackwater treatment hookup is ready at the temporary village wastewater collection manifold, and the minimum potable water delivery flow reaches 190 L/min at the site main water distribution meter.
